paragraphs: R' Tanhum bar Iskolastika: Jerusalem Tefillat ha-Shahar, mishnah 2. Musaf Arukh writes on Bereshit Rabbah, at “There was famine in the land”: “Let R' Yehoshua ben Hananyah enter, for he is an askolastikhi of Torah.” In Greek and Roman language it means learned and diligent in the study hall. Perhaps this is R' Tanhum, the son of R' Yehoshua ben Hananyah. End of quotation.
